registered_before: which computation (control selection, feature, model, score) had not yet been run or viewed
question: one sentence
primary_endpoint: one metric, one aggregation, one unit of independence
decision_rule: when is an effect called established (paired interval excludes zero), when is it not
must_not_change: list of frozen artifacts and results that stay read-only
comparisons_counted: number of variants/comparisons that will be looked at; all are reported
